# Wiktionary fixtures

French sections of real pages from the French Wiktionary (https://fr.wiktionary.org), used to test
the parser offline: `rapide`, `rapides`, `marchait`, `doux`, `clair`, `amour`, `heureux`.

Content licensed under **CC BY-SA 4.0** — authors: Wiktionary contributors (see each page's
history). Retrieved via the MediaWiki API (`action=parse&prop=wikitext`).
